name: SPEARHEAD: IDONETH DEEPKIN AKHELIAN TIDE GUARD
description:
An Akhelian King or Queen always rides the current to battle accompanied by a Tide Guard of their finest warriors. These figureheads of the Idoneth military are far too vital to leave unprotected, even with their prodigious skill at arms. Akhelian bodyguards and Namarti warriors alike stand ready to put beast and body in the path of any blows intended for their master.

If you want to raid the Mortal Realms and claim the souls of the living, this box is the perfect way to start a new Idoneth Deepkin collection – or expand an existing army – and save money compared to buying the kits individually. A valiant Akhelion King leads the force, ready to engage the enemy. In their wake come elite eel-riding units, ready to savage the foe with fang and blade. Rounding out the force is a unit of Namarti Reavers, claiming objectives and raining arrows down upon enemies from afar. These miniatures comprise a complete Spearhead force, meaning you're ready to jump into tight, tactical games straight out of the box, and launch your next raid from the depths.

This boxed set builds 17 multipart plastic Idoneth Deepkin miniatures:
– 1x Akhelian King (which can alternatively be built as Volturnos, High King of the Deep)
– 3x Akhelian Ishlaen Guard (which can alternatively be built as Akhelian Morrsarr Guard)
– 3x Akhelian Morrsarr Guard (which can alternatively be built as Akhelian Ishlaen Guard)
– 10x Namarti Reavers

The miniatures in this box are easy to customise. The Akhelian King has a choice of two different weapons and three heads. The kit can alternatively be assembled as the legendary Volturnos, ruler of the Idoneth Deepkin.

The six Akhelion Ishlaen Guard can alternatively be assembled as Morrsarr Guard – whichever you choose, you can build an optional champion, musician, and standard bearer for the unit. There are also cosmetic accessories to further customise your miniatures, including pouches, sheathed knives, and more.

The Namarti Reavers can be built firing their whisperbows or with their keening blades drawn. You can also build an optional champion for the unit.

The miniatures in this box are also available separately.

The kit comprises 298 plastic components, 6x Citadel 60mm by 35mm Oval Bases, 1x Citadel 60mm Round Base, 10x Citadel 32mm Round Bases, and 6x Citadel Flying Stems.

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
